falsification_conditions.condition: The primary equity index closes at least 3.0% above its highest close of the prior 20 sessions on two consecutive sessions, and the mini_top_2019_jun pattern match falls below 50%.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained breakout plus loss of the analogue would show this is trend continuation, not an unresolved mini-top, so UNKNOWN and HOLD would be wrong.

falsification_conditions.condition: The primary equity index closes more than 5.0% below its highest close of the prior 20 sessions, and the blowoff score prints at or above 75 on the same day.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sharp break with a confirmed blowoff reading would resolve the call into an actual top, falsifying both UNKNOWN and HOLD.

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 13.0 while high-yield OAS tightens by at least 25 bps from today's level and the index sets a new 20-session closing high.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Simultaneous vol compression, credit tightening, and a new high would contradict mini-top risk and show the HOLD was incorrectly cautious.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
